y-m-37-01.title: Kuongorora mhinduro yakawana mamiriro ekuva nemaroots chaiwo
y-m-37-01.topic: Mamiriro emaroots chaiwo eequation ine coefficient yetsamba: kufungidzira kuti iquadratic equation
y-m-37-01.goal: Nzwisisa kuti muequation ine tsamba mucoefficient, rudzi rwemutaurire runogona kuchinja zvichienderana nekukosha kwetsamba, uye gadzika chiyero chemhedziso kuti chienderane nemamiriro ari muchirevo chedambudziko.
y-m-37-01.material: Minjae akagadzirisa dambudziko rinotevera. "Wana chiyero chekukosha kwe k umo quadratic equation kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (k inhamba chaiyo) ine maroots chaiwo." (Maitiro ekuverenga: k times x squared, minus 4x, plus 1 equals 0.) Real root zvinoreva root iri nhamba chaiyo. Tarisa kugadzirisa kwaMinjae mutsara umwe panguva.
y-m-37-01.thinking.1: Tonga kuti mhinduro inochinja sei kana mamiriro edambudziko achichinja
y-m-37-01.thinking.2: Wana uye uongorore wega nyaya dzemiganhu
y-m-37-01.prereq.0: H3 yemushando uyu inongova kupatsanura kwekuoma panhanho yekugadzira; haireve kuti zvinhu izvi zvinopiwa kugiredhi ripi neripi. Fungidzira mudzidzi akatodzidza zvinhu zvakanyorwa pazasi.
y-m-37-01.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pediscriminant yequadratic equation nenhamba yemaroots chaiwo
y-m-37-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe unoita kuti mhedziso yaMinjae isaite nyore kuvimbwa sezvakaita. Verenga zvakare chirevo chedambudziko uye uongorore mutsara umwe panguva.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.0: Wana mashoko ari muchirevo chekutanga chedambudziko anotaura rudzi rweequation, uye uongorore kana kukosha kwose kwe k kunoita mamiriro iwayo kwakaratidzwa mumhedziso.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza integer yakareruka zvikuru pakati pekukosha kwe k kwakasanganisirwa mumhedziso, iise mumutaurire, uye utaure kuti imutaurire werudzi rupi.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.0: Kuti quadratic equation kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ive nemaroots chaiwo, discriminant inofanira kuita D ≥ 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka chiyero chinodiwa che k i k ≤ 4.
y-m-37-01.s.s1.explain: Dambudziko rakati kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 i "quadratic equation." Kuti ive quadratic equation, coefficient k ye x² haifanire kuva 0. Mutsara 1 wakatanga kushandisa discriminant usina kuongorora mamiriro aya, uye mhedziso k ≤ 4 mumutsara 4 inosanganisira k = 0. Kuverenga kwemitsara 2 ne3 kwakarurama. Mhinduro chaiyo i k ≤ 4 uye k ≠ 0. Kana wakasarudza mutsara 1 kana mutsara 4, poinzi huru inobva panzvimbo imwe chete.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.prompt: Kana mashoko e "quadratic equation" akasiiwa mudambudziko uye rakabvunza "chiyero che k umo equation kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ine maroots chaiwo," mhinduro yaizova chii?
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.0: Isa k = 0 ne k = 4 mumutaurire uye uwane mhinduro iwe amene.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.hint.1: Maka kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inobvumira k = 0 here kana kwete, uye uenzanise nemhinduro dzawakawana iwe amene.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.a: k < 4. Kana discriminant i0, pane double root, saka inobviswa.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.a: Kana D = 0, pane real root imwe, double root. "Ine real root" inosanganisira double root futi.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.b: k ≤ 4 uye k ≠ 0. Kana k = 0, haisi mutaurire wequadratic, saka hapana mhinduro.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.b: Kana k = 0, inova −4x + 1 = 0 uye pane real root x = 1/4. Kusava mutaurire wequadratic hakureve kuti hapana mhinduro.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.c: k ≤ 4. Pane real root kana k = 0 futi.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.o.d: k ≥ 4. Sarudza divi umo discriminant i0 kana kupfuura.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.r.d: Tarisa zvakare nzira yechiratidzo che inequality kana uchigadzirisa D = 16 − 4k ≥ 0 kuti uwane k. Semuenzaniso, isa k = 0 ne k = 5 uye uenzanise kana pane real root chaiyo.
y-m-37-01.s.s2.explain: Kana ichingoti "equation," k = 0 inobvumirwawo. Kana k = 0, saka −4x + 1 = 0 uye pane real root x = 1/4, saka renji re k ndi k ≤ 4 (rinosanganisira 0). Kunyangwe nemhinduro imwe chete, mhedziso inogona kusiyana zvichienderana nemamiriro ari mushoko renyaya (kana iri quadratic equation kana kuti kwete).
y-m-37-01.s.s3.prompt: Tsvaga makosha maviri akasiyana e k apo equation kx² − 4x + 1 = 0 (panguva ino haifaniri kuva quadratic equation) ine real root imwe chete yakasiyana.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mamiriro ekuva ne real root imwe chete kana coefficient ye x² isiri 0.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora expression yenyaya apo coefficient ye x² iri 0 uye uverenge kuti ine mhinduro dzakawanda sei.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.ok.c1: Ne k iyi, equation ine real root imwe chete.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.fail.c1: Ne k iyi, verenga kuti equation ine real roots dzakasiyana dzakawanda sei. Verenga uchiparadzanisa kana coefficient ye x² iri 0 kana kuti kwete.
y-m-37-01.s.s3.explain: Kana k = 4, saka 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)², saka pane x = 1/2 chete, uye kana k = 0, saka −4x + 1 = 0, saka pane x = 1/4 chete. Iyo k = 4 apo discriminant iri 0 haikwani oga; unofanirawo kutarisa zvakaparadzana k = 0, apo rudzi rwe expression runochinja.

y-m-37-07.title: Mhinduro dzakawanikwa naSua ndidzo dzese here?
y-m-37-07.topic: Range yekusarudza ma candidates kana uchiwana mhinduro dze cubic equation, nehwaro hwemhedziso
y-m-37-07.goal: Ziva kuti cubic equation ine integer coefficients inogona kuva nemhinduro dzisiri ma integers, uye utsanangurire shamwari zvakakodzera kuti sei huwandu hwemhinduro dzawakawana hahugone kukuita kuti utaure "ndazviwana dzese."
y-m-37-07.material: Sua akagadzirisa dambudziko rekuwana real solutions dzese dze cubic equation 2x³ − x² − 7x + 6 = 0 (Maitiro ekuverenga: 2 x cubed minus x squared minus 7 x plus 6 equals 0) seizvi.
y-m-37-07.thinking.1: Wana uye utarise iwe pachako mhinduro yakasiyiwa
y-m-37-07.prereq.1: Kuisa mutengo mu polynomial kutarisa kana i 0
y-m-37-07.prereq.2: Kunyora cubic expression se product ye linear expression ne quadratic expression
y-m-37-07.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mumhinduro yaSua unoomera kuvimba nawo. Tarisa zvakaparadzana kana kuverenga kwemutsetse mumwe nemumwe kwakarurama uye kana logic yakarurama.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.0: Dzokorora iwe pachako kuverenga kwekuisa kwemitsetse 2 ne 3 uye utarise kana mitengo yakarurama.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.hint.1: Mumutsetse 4, wana kana "at most 3" ne "only these two" zvichireva zvakafanana. Semuenzaniso, mu (x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3) = 0, zvinoitika sei kana ukawana mhinduro mbiri chete ukamira?
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.0: Kana pane mhinduro, dziri pakati pema divisors e constant term 6, ±1, ±2, ±3, ±6, saka tinoedza idzi sere chete.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.1: x = 1: 2 − 1 − 7 + 6 = 0, saka i mhinduro. x = −2: −16 − 4 + 14 + 6 = 0, saka i mhinduro.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.2: Ma candidates akasara ±3, ±6, 2, −1 ese haasi 0 kana akaiswa.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.line.3: Cubic equation ine mhinduro 3 pakanyanya uye takawana 2, saka mhinduro i x = 1 ne x = −2 chete.
y-m-37-07.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 1: mhinduro kana i integer chete iri pakati pema divisors e constant term. Kana leading coefficient i 2, mhinduro ye fraction sa 3/2 inogonekawo. Mutsetse 4: "at most 3" zvinoreva kuti pangava ne 3 pakanyanya, saka kuwana 2 hakusi chikonzero chekutaura kuti hapana dzimwe. Kuverenga kwemitsetse 2 ne 3 kwakarurama.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.prompt: Wana mhinduro yechitatu ye real yakasiyiwa naSua uye uiise se decimal. (Inyore se decimal, sa 0.5, semuenzaniso.)
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti chokwadi chekuti mhinduro x = 1 ne x = −2 dzinozivikanwa chinoisa muganhu upi pachimiro che cubic expression.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora muganhu uwo, wana expression yakapfava yasara, wobva waisa x inoita kuti expression iyoyo ive 0 mu equation yekutanga kuti utarise.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Kana ukaisa mutengo uyu, expression inova 0.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Isa mutengo wawakaisa mu expression uye uverenge iwe pachako kana ichiva 0.
y-m-37-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Unofanira kuwana mutengo usiri umwe wemhinduro dzatowanikwa naSua (1 ne −2).
y-m-37-07.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaisa x = 3/2 = 1.5, saka 2·(27/8) − 9/4 − 21/2 + 6 = 0. Equation inogona kunyorwa se (x − 1)(x + 2)(2x − 3) = 0, saka pane mhinduro nhatu, 1, −2, 3/2. 3/2 haisi divisor ye 6.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora meseji kuna Sua. Fungidzira shamwari yegiredhi re9 ichaiverenga. Isanganisire kuti sei mhedziso yaSua yakaipa, mhinduro yakashaikwa i ipi, uye chii chaizonaka kutarisa kana ukagadzirisa dambudziko rakafanana nguva inotevera.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wabvuma mhinduro mbiri dzatowanikwa naSua, wobva wanyora mushoko rimwe kuti kupatsika kwakatangira kupi.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mhinduro imwe yakashaikwa uye uwedzere mushoko rinoisa mutengo uyu mu equation yekutanga kuti utarise.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakatsanangura chikonzero ndisingapi mhosva Sua pakanganisa here?
y-m-37-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakapa Sua chinhu chimwe chaicho chekutarisa pachake nguva inotevera here?
y-m-37-07.s.s3.model.0: Sua, wakaedza ma divisors e 6 chete, saka wakawana mhinduro dze integer chete. Equation iyi ine leading coefficient ye 2, saka mhinduro dze fraction sa 3/2 dzinogonekawo. Kana ukapatsanura ne mhinduro 1, unowana (x − 1)(2x² + x − 6), uye iyi i (x − 1)(2x − 3)(x + 2), saka mhinduro i 1, −2, 3/2.
y-m-37-07.s.s3.model.1: Kwaiva kukanganisa kutaura kuti yapera nekuti pane mhinduro mbiri. "At most three" zvinoreva kuti pangava nenhatu, saka imwe inogona kushaikwa. Kana ukaisa x = 3/2, saka 2·27/8 − 9/4 − 21/2 + 6 = 0. Nguva inotevera, tarisa kana wakaganhurira ma candidates kuma integers chete.

y-m-37-05.title: Kutarisa chirevo chekuti "kana graph isingasangani ne x-axis, inogara ichishanda"
y-m-37-05.topic: Mamiriro ekuti quadratic inequality igare ichishanda: discriminant ne leading coefficient
y-m-37-05.goal: Ratidza nemienzaniso inopikisa kuti kuti quadratic inequality ishande kune real numbers dzose mamiriro e discriminant oga haakwani uye chiratidzo che leading coefficient chinodiwawo, uye utaure kuti muganhu (D = 0) unoreva chii.
y-m-37-05.material: Soyoung akazvipfupisa seizvi: "Kune quadratic inequality ax² + bx + c > 0 (a ≠ 0, a, b, c ndema real numbers), kana discriminant D = b² − 4ac iri pasi pe0, inequality iyi inoshanda kune real numbers x dzose." (Nzira yekuverenga: a x squared plus b x plus c is greater than 0.)
y-m-37-05.thinking.1: Gadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inopikisa yerudzi rwumwe norumwe
y-m-37-05.thinking.2: Nyora zvakare mamiriro kuti ave echokwadi
y-m-37-05.prereq.1: Graph ye quadratic function (inovhurika nepamusoro/nepasi) nenzvimbo yayo zvichienzaniswa ne x-axis
y-m-37-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwakakodzera nezve chipfupiso chaSoyoung.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kana graph ye y = ax² + 1 iri pamusoro kana pazasi pe x-axis kana a = 1 uye kana a = −1.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza (a, b, c) imwe ine D < 0, uise x = 0, uye utarise kana inequality inoshanda.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.a: Inogara iri yechokwadi sezvayakaita. Kana D < 0, parabola haisangani ne x-axis.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.a: Zvechokwadi kuti parabola haisangani ne x-axis, asi kuti parabola iri pamusoro kana pazasi pe x-axis nyaya yakasiyana.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.b: Kana D < 0, haishande pa x chero ipi.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.b: Funga muenzaniso une a > 0, x² + 1 > 0. D = −4, asi inoshanda pa x dzese.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.c: Haugone kuziva kana yakarurama kusvikira waisa nhamba mu a, b, c.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.r.c: Kuisa nhamba i nzira yakanakawo, asi kana ukafunga nezvechimiro che parabola, unogona kutonga usina nhamba.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.o.d: Kana a i negative, haishande, saka yakaipa sezvayakaita.
y-m-37-05.s.s1.explain: Kana D < 0, parabola y = ax² + bx + c haisangani ne x-axis. Asi kana a < 0, parabola iri pasi pe x-axis chete, saka inequality haishande pa x chero ipi. Semuenzaniso, −x² − 1 > 0 haina x inoshanda (D = −4 < 0).
y-m-37-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma integer triples maviri (a, b, c) emarudzi akasiyana apo discriminant D = b² − 4ac i 0 kana kushoma, asi ax² + bx + c > 0 haishande pa real numbers dzese x. Marudzi: i marudzi akasiyana kana simbi ye a yakasiyana, kana kuti D i 0 kana kwete kwakasiyana.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti chimiro che parabola chinosiyana sei kana a i positive nekana a i negative, uye kuti inosangana ne x-axis pamapoinzi mangani kana D i 0.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.hint.1: Pa (a, b, c) yawakasarudza, isa mitengo yakawanda pa x uye uwane x imwe apo inequality haishande, kuti utarise.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a i integer isiri 0, uye b ne c i ma integers zvakare.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva integer isiri 0, uye b ne c inofanira kuva ma integers zvakare.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Verenga D = b² − 4ac. Inofanira kuva 0 kana kushoma.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Inequality iyi haishande pa real number x imwe.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana a > 0 ne D < 0, inoshanda pa x dzese. Unofanira kugadzira muenzaniso une x apo haishande. Funga chimiro chinovhurika kumusoro kana pasi nenzvimbo yayo kuna x-axis.
y-m-37-05.s.s2.explain: (−1, 0, −1) inopa −x² − 1 > 0, isingashande pa x chero ipi (D = −4, a < 0). (1, 2, 1) inopa x² + 2x + 1 = (x + 1)² > 0, iyo inova 0 pa x = −1, saka haishande (D = 0, a > 0). (−1, 2, −1) inopa −(x − 1)² > 0, isingashande pa x chero ipi (D = 0, a < 0). Pane marudzi matatu akasiyana.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare chirevo chaSoyoung kuti chive chechokwadi. Nyorawo pfungwa dzako nezvekuti ax² + bx + c > 0 inoshanda pa real numbers dzese kana D = 0.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa chii chakasiyana mu counterexamples dzawakagadzira kare musimbi ye a nemutengo we D.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.hint.1: Mumuenzaniso une D = 0 sa (1, 2, 1), wana x apo expression inova 0.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Theorem yandakagadzirisa inosefa counterexamples dzese dzandakagadzira kare here?
y-m-37-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura kuti x ipi apo mutengo we expression unova 0 kana D = 0 here?
y-m-37-05.s.s3.model.0: Inogara ichishanda kana a > 0 uye D < 0 chete. Kana D = 0, mutengo i 0 pa x = −b/(2a), saka > 0 haishande.
y-m-37-05.s.s3.model.1: Zvakakwana kuti parabola ivhurike kumusoro (a i positive) uye discriminant i negative. Kana discriminant i 0, parabola inobata x-axis uye mutengo i 0 papoinzi iyoyo, saka haigari ichishanda.

y-m-37-08.topic: Huwandu hwemhinduro dze integer dze system ye inequalities nekana mutengo wemuganhu unosanganisirwa
y-m-37-08.goal: Ziva kuti kana huwandu hwemhinduro dze integer dze system ye inequalities hwakasimbiswa, parameter inogona kuva nemitengo yakawanda, uye utonge nekutarisa zvakananga kana mutengo wemuganhu unosanganisirwa.
y-m-37-08.material: Funga system ye inequalities { x² − x − 6 < 0, x > a } (a i real number). Mhinduro ye inequality yekutanga i −2 < x < 3. (Maitiro ekuverenga: x squared minus x minus 6 i less than 0, uye panguva imwechete x i greater than a.) Huwandu hwema integers x anogutsa ma inequalities ese maviri hunochinja ne a.

y-m-37-08.prereq.3: Chikamu chakafanana che system ye inequalities

y-m-37-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora ma integers ese ari mu −2 < x < 3.
y-m-37-08.s.s1.hint.1: Chengeta anogutsa x > 0 chete, asi tarisa kana 0 pachayo ichisara.
y-m-37-08.s.s1.r.a: Verenga zvakare ma integers ari mu −2 < x < 3 anogutsa x > 0.
y-m-37-08.s.s1.r.b: x > 0 haina equals sign, saka x = 0 haigutsi.
y-m-37-08.s.s1.r.d: Iwo i ma integers anogutsa inequality yekutanga chete, pasina kushandisa mamiriro x > a pa a.
y-m-37-08.s.s1.explain: Ma integers ari mu −2 < x < 3 i −1, 0, 1, 2, uye anogutsa x > 0 i 1, 2. Muchiratidzo che inequality x > a, chisina equals sign, x = a pachayo haisi mhinduro.
y-m-37-08.s.s2.prompt: Wana mitengo 3 yakasiyana ye a apo ma integers x 2 chaizvo anogutsa ma inequalities ese maviri (ma decimals akanaka).
y-m-37-08.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ma integers ese ari mu −2 < x < 3, uye painochinja a, maka rimwe nerimwe kuti ma integers api anogutsa x > a.

y-m-37-08.s.s3.hint.0: Isa a = 0 ne a = 1 imwe neimwe mu x > a, uye uronge ma integers anosara mu −2 < x < 3.
y-m-37-08.s.s3.hint.1: Enzanisa huwandu hwemhinduro dze integer muchiitiko chimwe nechimwe ne 2.

y-m-37-04.topic: Kusangana kwe line ne parabola: kutarisa makosha mashoma nesimba reumboo
y-m-37-04.goal: Ziva kuti mhedzisiro yekuedza makosha mashoma oga haigoni kupedzisa kuti "hapana nyaya yakadaro," uye shandisa equation kutsvaga chaizvo nyaya apo vanobatana uye utsanangure.
y-m-37-04.material: Huwandu hwemapoinzi apo line y = x + k inosangana ne parabola y = x² inochinja ne k (real number). Hayun haana kudhirowa graph; akaisa makosha mu k, akawana mapoinzi ekusangana zvakananga, uye akagadzira tafura. Huwandu hwemapoinzi ekusangana mutafura ndi0 kana k = −1, 2 kana k = 0, 2 kana k = 1, uye 2 kana k = 2 (zvose zvakaverengwa zvakarurama). Hayun akati, "Ndakatarisa ma integer k ose mana, saka hapana nyaya apo line inobata parabola (inosangana nayo pamapoinzi mumwe chete)."

y-m-37-09.topic: Maximum ye quadratic function nedomain yakaganhurirwa: kana vertex i kunze kwerange yakabvumirwa

y-m-37-09.material: Uchishandisa guwa rewaya rose re 24 m, tinoruka mativi matatu chete embhedha yemaruva ye rectangle. Divi rakasara rakaiswa pamadziro uye harina guwa. y-m-37-02.title: Kana root imwe ndi1+2i, imwe root ndeipi?
y-m-37-02.topic: Complex roots nemamiriro e coefficients: kufungidzira kunoita kuti hukama pakati pe roots ne coefficients ushande
y-m-37-02.goal: Ziva kuti kuti utaure "imwe root ndiyo conjugate complex number" kune quadratic equation ine complex root yakapiwa, unoda mamiriro e coefficients, uye ugadzire iwe pachako zvimwe zvinogoneka kana mamiriro asipo.
y-m-37-02.material: Root imwe ye quadratic equation x² + px + q = 0 ndi1 + 2i. (i ndiyo imaginary unit ine i² = −1. Nzira yekuverenga: x squared plus p x plus q equals 0.) Hyunjun akati, "Saka imwe root ndi1 − 2i, saka tinogona kuwana p ne q."
y-m-37-02.thinking.0: Tonga kuti ruzivo rupi rwakakwana kumhedziso
y-m-37-02.thinking.2: Gadzira muenzaniso unopikisa kana mamiriro asipo
y-m-37-02.prereq.1: Kuwedzera nekuwedzera kwema complex numbers, uye ma conjugate complex numbers
y-m-37-02.prereq.2: Hukama pakati pe roots ne coefficients ye quadratic equation (sum ne product ye roots mbiri)
y-m-37-02.s.s1.prompt: Sezvinotaura Hyunjun, kuti uwane p ne q unoda ruzivo rwekuwedzera rusiri mushoko renyaya. Sarudza zvose zvinotevera apo kuwedzera ruzivo rumwe chete runogadzirisa p ne q imwe neimwe kukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, daidza imwe root kuti r, uye unyore mamiriro anofanira kugutswa ne1 + 2i ne r.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kana unogona kugadzira r mbiri dzakasiyana dzinogutsa sarudzo imwe neimwe. Kana unogona kugadzira mbiri, ruzivo irworwo oga harukwani.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.a: Chero bedzi p iri integer, makosha akawanda anogoneka, senge p = 0, p = 1, nezvimwewo. Semuenzaniso, kana p = 0, imwe root ndi−1 − 2i, inosiyana nenyaya apo p = −2.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.b: Kana iri double root, roots mbiri dzose dzakatarwa se1 + 2i, saka p ne q dzakatarwawo. Hazvina basa kuti ma coefficients anova complex numbers.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.o.c: p ne q zvose ndema real numbers.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.c: Kana p ne q dziri real, imwe root ndiyo conjugate complex number kuti ma imaginary parts abvisane, uye p ne q dzakatarwa.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.o.d: q ndi real number. p hazvizikanwi.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.r.d: Kuziva kuti q iri real chete hakutari imwe root. Semuenzaniso, kana imwe root ndi2 − 4i, saka q = 10 iri real, asi p = −3 + 2i haisi real.
y-m-37-02.s.s1.explain: Kana p ne q zvose zviri real, imwe root yakatarwa se1 − 2i, uye p = −2, q = 5. Kana iri double root, roots mbiri dzose ndi1 + 2i, saka p = −2 − 4i ne q = −3 + 4i dzakatarwa, asi ma coefficients haasi real. Ruzivo rwekuti p ndi integer kana q iri real harutari imwe root kuimwe chete. Unogona kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana nekubvunza kuti, "Pane imwe root imwe chete here inogutsa ruzivo urwu?"
y-m-37-02.s.s2.prompt: Zvino fungidzira kuti p ne q zvose ndema real numbers. Sarudza mutsara wakashata mumhinduro apo Hyunjun akawana p ne q.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.0: Wedzera x² + px + q = (x − root1)(x − root2) iwe pachako uye unyore kuti coefficient ye x ne constant term zvinotaurwa sei nema roots.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isa p ne q dzawakawana mu expression yekutanga, uise x = 1 + 2i, uye utarise kana inova 0. (1 + 2i)² = −3 + 4i.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.line.0: Sezvo p ne q dziri real, kana root imwe ichiva 1 + 2i, imwe root ndiyo conjugate complex number 1 − 2i.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.line.2: Nehukama pakati pe roots ne coefficients, sum yema roots maviri ndi p, saka p = 2.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.line.3: Product yema roots maviri ndi (1 + 2i)(1 − 2i) = 1 + 4 = 5, saka q = 5.
y-m-37-02.s.s2.explain: Kuwedzera x² + px + q = (x − root1)(x − root2), coefficient ye x ndi −(root1 + root2), saka sum yema roots maviri ndi −p. Chiratidzo chakashata mumutsara we3, uye kukosha kwakarurama ndi p = −2. Iyo q = 5 yemutsara we4 yakarurama. Mutsara 1 ishoko rinogona kushandiswa chete kana p ne q dziri real, asi rakanyorwa mushure mekutaura mamiriro, saka zvakanaka.
y-m-37-02.s.s3.prompt: Kana asina kutaurwa kuti p ne q dziri real, haugoni kuva nechokwadi chekuti "imwe root ndi1 − 2i." Sarudza muenzaniso mumwe apo imwe root isiri 1 − 2i, uye utsanangure nekunyora kuti p ne q dzinova nhamba dzipi ipapo.
y-m-37-02.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza imwe root, wozowedzera (x − 1 − 2i)(x − iyo root) uye unyore coefficient ye x ne constant term.
y-m-37-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe kuti p ne q dzawakawana dziri real here kana kuti kwete.
y-m-37-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakaverenga p ne q nekuwedzera (x − root1)(x − root2) ini pachangu, ndichishandisa imwe root yandakasarudza ne1 + 2i here?
y-m-37-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakatarisa here kuti imwe chete yema p ne q dzandakawana haisi real number?
y-m-37-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana imwe root ndi3, saka x² + px + q = (x − 1 − 2i)(x − 3), saka p = −4 − 2i ne q = 3 + 6i. Sezvo p ne q dzisiri real, imwe root haifaniri kuva conjugate complex number.
y-m-37-02.s.s3.model.1: Kana ndikasarudza imwe root kuti ive 0, saka q = 0 ne p = −1 − 2i. Izvi zvinogona kuitika nekuti p ndi complex number. Conjugate complex number inobuda chete kana pane mamiriro e real coefficients.
y-m-37-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Uyu muenzaniso apo q iri real asi p isiri real.

y-m-37-10.title: Nhamba mbiri dzine huwandu 10: chakawanikwa chinogona kuva chikuru zvakadini?
y-m-37-10.topic: Kana nhamba mbiri dzine huwandu nechakawanikwa chakapiwa dziripo, nokuenzanisa nzira mbiri dzokugadzirisa
y-m-37-10.goal: Tsvaga kana nhamba mbiri chaiyo dzine huwandu nechakawanikwa chakapiwa dziripo uchishandisa mamiriro emidzi chaiyo yechirevo che quadratic, uye uenzanise simba rehumbowo hwetafura inounganidza nhamba dzizere chete nehwechirevo chinobata nhamba chaiyo dzose.
y-m-37-10.material: Ngatiti p ne q ive nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzine huwandu 10, uye ngatiti chakawanikwa chazvo pq chive P. Shamwari mbiri dzakashandisa nzira dzakasiyana kuziva kana nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzakadaro dziripo kana P yakapiwa. Gaeun: ngatiti p = t uye q = 10 − t, uye utsvage kana t(10 − t) = P, ndiko kuti, t² − 10t + P = 0, ine mudzi chaiyo t. Narae: chinja t kuva 0, 1, 2, … uye ugadzire tafura yezvakawanikwa. y-m-37-10.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza tsananguro inokodzera zvikuru inoenzanisa nzira mbiri pamusoro pokuti pane nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzine chakawanikwa 26 here.

y-m-37-10.s.s1.o.a: Nzira mbiri dzinosvika pamhedziso imwe chete, saka tafura yaNarae oga yakakwana.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.r.a: Kunyange mhedziso dzakafanana, simba rehumbowo rinosiyana. Tafura yaNarae ine chete t nhamba dzizere.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.o.b: Hapana 26 patafura, saka nzira yaNarae, inoratidza zvakawanikwa zvakananga, inovimbika zvikuru.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.r.b: Kuti hapana 26 patafura mhedzisiro yokutarisa t nhamba dzizere chete. Nyaya dzine t sedhesimali hadzisipo patafura.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.o.c: Nzira yaGaeun inogona kushandiswa chete kana P iri nhamba yakazara.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.r.c: t² − 10t + P = 0 inogona kushandiswa nenzira imwe chete kunyange P iri dhesimali kana chikamu. Discriminant inogona kuverengwa kuna P chaiyo ipi neipi.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.o.d: Tafura inobata chete t nhamba dzizere, asi chirevo chaGaeun chinobata t chaiyo dzose.
y-m-37-10.s.s1.explain: Tafura yaNarae inobata chete t nhamba dzizere, saka haigoni kusarudza kuti 26 hazvigoneki. Asi, chimiro chokuti chakaenzana uye chikuru zvikuru pa 5 chiratidzo chakanaka chokuti 25 ndicho chakawanda zvikuru. Chirevo chaGaeun chinobata t chaiyo dzose, saka chinogona kusarudza mubvunzo nokuti discriminant 100 − 4P iri negative here.
y-m-37-10.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nhamba dzizere 3 dzakasiyana P dzokuti pane nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzakasiyana dzine huwandu 10 nechakawanikwa P, uye nhamba mbiri idzodzo hadzisi nhamba dzizere.
y-m-37-10.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga watsvaga mhando ye P apo discriminant yechirevo chaGaeun t² − 10t + P = 0 iri pamusoro.
y-m-37-10.s.s2.hint.1: Kune dzimwe nhamba dzizere P dziri mumhando iyoyo, tsvaga iwe pachako nhamba mbiri uye utarise kana dziri nhamba dzizere.
y-m-37-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Tsvaga nechirevo chaGaeun kuti chakawanikwa chinofanira kuva mumhando ipi kuti nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzakasiyana dzine huwandu 10 dziripo.
y-m-37-10.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsvaga chaizvo nhamba mbiri dzeP iyoyo uye utarise kana dziri nhamba dzizere.
y-m-37-10.s.s2.explain: Midzi ye t² − 10t + P = 0 ndi t = 5 ± √(25 − P). Kana P < 25, pane nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzakasiyana, uye kana 25 − P isiri sikweya yakakwana, hadzisi nhamba dzizere. P = 24 inopa 4 ne 6, dzinhamba dzizere; P = 25 inopa 5 chete; uye P = 26 haipi nhamba chaiyo.
y-m-37-10.s.s3.prompt: Humbowo hupi hwaunoda kuti utaure kuti hapana nhamba chaiyo mbiri dzine chakawanikwa 26? Sarudza nzira yaGaeun kana yaNarae uye unyore humbowo, uye unyorewo kuti humbowo hwenzira iyoyo hwakasimba zvakadini pamubvunzo uyu.
y-m-37-10.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga discriminant ye t²−10t+26=0 uye utarise chiratidzo chayo. Kana nyora zvakare t(10−t) muchimiro chine (t−5)².
y-m-37-10.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mutsara mumwe pachimwe chinhu chinoratidzwa netafura yaNarae nezvisingagoni kuratidzwa.
y-m-37-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakaratidza here, nenzira yandakasarudza, nenhamba kana chirevo, kuti sei chakawanikwa 26 hachigoneki?
y-m-37-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura here musiyano wokuva nechokwadi pakati pe "tafura inotarisa nhamba dzizere chete" ne "chirevo chinobata nhamba chaiyo dzose"?
y-m-37-10.s.s3.model.0: Nenzira yaGaeun, discriminant ye t² − 10t + 26 = 0 ndi 100 − 104 = −4, iri negative, saka hapana mudzi chaiyo t. Saka hapana nhamba chaiyo dzine huwandu 10 nechakawanikwa 26. Inobata t chaiyo dzose, saka humbowo hwakasimba.
y-m-37-10.s.s3.model.1: t(10 − t) = −(t − 5)² + 25, saka chakawanikwa hachigoni kupfuura 25. Saka 26 haigoni kugadzirwa. Tafura yaNarae ine nhamba dzizere chete, saka chiratidzo chokuti 25 ndicho chakawanda zvikuru asi haigoni kuzvisarudza.

y-m-37-03.title: Fractional equation ine mhinduro dzakawanda sei?
y-m-37-03.topic: Kutarisa vakasarudzwa vanoonekwa kana uchiwedzera divi rega rega re fractional equation ne expression
y-m-37-03.goal: Ziva kuti mhinduro dze equation yaunowana nekuwedzera mativi ose maviri ne expression ine letter dzinogona kusafanana nemhinduro dze equation yekutanga, uye utonge uye ugadzire iwe pachako kana mhinduro dzichisara kana dzose dzichisara.
y-m-37-03.material: Tinobvumirana kusabvumira x inoita kuti denominator ive 0, uye tinotsvaga mhinduro dze equation. Ruzivo runoratidzwa rumwe nerumwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kufunga kwako.
y-m-37-03.thinking.0: Kuchinja kana kuchengeta kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva
y-m-37-03.prereq.1: Kuverenga nema fractional expressions (ma expressions ane letter mu denominator)
y-m-37-03.prereq.3: Chibvumirano chekuti kukosha kunoita kuti denominator ive 0 hakubvumirwi
y-m-37-03.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa rumwe nerumwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kufunga kwako nezve kuti mhinduro ndedzipi.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.hint.0: Padanho rimwe nerimwe, isa vakasarudzwa zvakananga mu equation yekutanga uye uenzanise makosha emativi ose maviri.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga wanyora kukosha kwe x kunoita kuti expression yakawedzerwa (x − 3 kana x − 2) ive 0, uye utarise kana kukosha ikoko kuri pakati pevakasarudzwa.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Takawedzera mativi ose maviri e equation x²/(x − 3) = 9/(x − 3) ne (x − 3) uye takawana x² = 9. (Nzira yekuverenga: x squared over x minus 3 equals 9 over x minus 3.)
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ungataura chii zvino nezve mhinduro dze equation iyi?
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Mhinduro 3 ne −3 dze x² = 9 vakasarudzwa. x = 3, inoita kuti expression yakawedzerwa x − 3 ive 0, inoita kuti denominator ive 0 mu equation yekutanga. Kune −3, unofanira kuiisa mu equation yekutanga uye utarise.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Vose x = 3 ne x = −3 mhinduro. Vose vanogutsa x² = 9.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: x² = 9 ndi equation itsva yatakawana nekuwedzera. Kuti mhinduro dze equation itsva dzakafanana nemhinduro dze equation yekutanga zvinofanira kutariswa zvakaparadzana.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: x = 3 inoita kuti denominator ive 0, saka haigoni kuva mhinduro.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakanaka, sezvo wakatanga wasefa kukosha kunoita kuti denominator ive 0. Rangaridzawo kuti hausati watarisa −3 zvakananga.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 3 ne −3 vakasarudzwa uye vanofanira kutariswa nekuvaisa mu equation yekutanga.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku kutonga kwekungwarira kunosiyanisa vakasarudzwa nemhinduro.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Pane kukosha kunoita kuti denominator ive 0, saka equation yose iyi haina zvainoreva.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Equation ine zvainoreva kune x ≠ 3. Kukosha kumwe chete kunoita kuti denominator ive 0 hakuiti kuti equation yose isava nezvainoreva.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana ukaisa x = −3 mu equation yekutanga, divi rekuruboshwe ndi9/(−6) = −3/2 uye divi rekurudyi rinewo 9/(−6) = −3/2, saka vakaenzana. Kana ukaisa x = 3, ma denominator ose maviri anova 0.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Solution set ye equation yekutanga ndeipi?
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Solution set ye equation yekutanga ndeipi?
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.after: x = 3 haina zvainoreva mu equation yekutanga, uye x = −3 inogutsa equation. Mhinduro dze equation yatakawana nekuwedzera dzinogona kuva dzakawanda kupfuura mhinduro dze equation yekutanga, saka kutarisa kunodiwa pakupedzisira.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: {3, −3}. Ma denominator emativi ose maviri akafanana, saka 3 inoshandawo.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana denominator iri 0, kukosha kwe expression pachayo hakutsanangurwi. Haugoni kutaura kuti inoshanda.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Hapana mhinduro. 3 haisi mhinduro, saka −3 haisi mhinduro zvakare.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kana wakaisa −3 zvakananga, mativi ose maviri akaenzana. Mumwe musarudzwa kubviswa hakureve kuti mumwe musarudzwa anobviswawo.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Panguva ino ndi equation yakasiyana, x/(x − 2) − 1 = 2/(x − 2). Equation iyi ine zvainoreva kune real numbers x ≠ 2 chete. Takawedzera mativi ose maviri ne (x − 2) uye takapfupisa, uye takawana x − (x − 2) = 2, ndiko kuti 2 = 2, saka x yakanyangarika.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.after: 2 = 2 yechokwadi pasinei ne x, saka x yose ine zvainoreva (x ≠ 2) ndiyo mhinduro. x = 2 inoita kuti denominator ive 0, saka haisi mhinduro.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hapana mhinduro. x yakanyangarika, saka hapana kukosha kwekutsvaga.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: 2 = 2 inogara ichiri yechokwadi. Kunyangarika kwe x hakureve kuti hapana x inogutsa mamiriro. Semuenzaniso, isa x = 5 mu equation yekutanga.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Real numbers dzose. 2 = 2 inogara ichiri yechokwadi.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: x = 2 inoita kuti denominator ye equation yekutanga ive 0. Kungova kuti equation inogara iri yechokwadi hakuiti kuti makosha asina zvaanoreva ave mhinduro.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Kana ukaisa x = 2 mu equation yekutanga, denominator inova 0.
y-m-37-03.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, wakabata sei x = 3 ne x = −3, uye mushure mekuvaisa mu equation yekutanga, kufunga kwako kwakachinja sei kana kuramba kwakadaro? Funga kuti nei kutarisa kunodiwa pakupedzisira kwemhinduro inowedzera mativi ose maviri ne expression, uye kuti kutarisa uku kunongoderedza huwandu hwemhinduro here (funga nezvenyaya yekupedzisira).
y-m-37-03.s.s2.prompt: Mu equation x²/(x − a) = c²/(x − a) (a ne c ndema real numbers, c ≠ 0), kuwedzera mativi ose maviri ne (x − a) kunopa x² = c². Tsvaga (a, c) mbiri dzinopa ma equations akasiyana, kuti pakati pevakasarudzwa x = c ne x = −c, mumwe asiri mhinduro ye equation yekutanga uye mumwe ari mhinduro.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora vakasarudzwa vaviri, unyore kukosha kwe x kunoita kuti denominator ive 0 mu equation yekutanga (x − a = 0), uye wozonyora zvinofanira kuitika kuti vaviri vacho vasangane.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora equation ine (a, c) yawakasarudza uye uise vakasarudzwa vaviri mu equation yekutanga kuti utarise.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.var.a: a (iyo a iri mu x − a ye denominator)
y-m-37-03.s.s2.var.c: c (iyo c iri mu c² ye numerator yekurudyi)
y-m-37-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Mumwe musarudzwa anoita kuti denominator ive 0 uye anobviswa, uye mumwe anosara semhinduro.
y-m-37-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora kuti hukama hupi pakati pe a ne c hunofanira kuvapo kuti mumwe wevakasarudzwa x = c ne x = −c aite kuti denominator x − a ive 0. (c haifaniri kuva 0.)
y-m-37-03.s.s2.explain: Kana a = c, saka x = c inoita kuti denominator ive 0 uye inobviswa, uye x = −c chete ndiyo inosara. Kana a = −c, saka x = −c inobviswa uye x = c inosara. Semuenzaniso, a = 3, c = 3 ndiyo equation yekutanga. Sezvo c ne −c dzichipa equation imwe chete, (a, 3) ne (a, −3) ndiyo equation imwe chete.

y-m-37-06.title: Pane quadratic inequality imwe chete ine mhinduro iri pakati pe −1 ne 3 here?
y-m-37-06.topic: Kudzorera ma coefficients kubva pamhinduro ye quadratic inequality: ruzivo rwakakwana here?
y-m-37-06.goal: Ratidza nemienzaniso yakawanda kuti interval yemhinduro ye quadratic inequality oga haisimbise ma coefficients sechimwe, uye inosimbisa simbi ye a chete, uye usarudze ruzivo rwunodiwa chaizvo kusimbisa ma coefficients sechimwe.
y-m-37-06.material: Mhinduro ye quadratic inequality ax² + bx + c > 0 i −1 < x < 3. Izvi zvinoreva kuti mhinduro i real numbers dzese dziri pakati pe −1 ne 3. (a, b, c i ma integers uye a ≠ 0. Maitiro ekuverenga: a x squared plus b x plus c i greater than 0.)
y-m-37-06.thinking.0: Tonga kana ruzivo rwakapiwa rwakakwana kumhedziso
y-m-37-06.thinking.2: Sarudza kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchipindirana neruzivo rwaunatorwo
y-m-37-06.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pemhinduro ye quadratic inequality negraph ye quadratic function
y-m-37-06.prereq.2: Kutarisa roots dze quadratic equation nema factors kana substitution
y-m-37-06.s.s1.prompt: Mutengo we a, b, c wakasimbiswa sechimwe neruzivo urwu oga here?
y-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.0: Gadzira iwe pachako ma quadratic inequalities maviri akasiyana ane mhinduro −1 < x < 3 uye uaenzanise.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora kuti mutengo we ax² + bx + c unofanira kuva chii pa x = −1 ne x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.a: Yakasimbiswa. Mativi maviri emhinduro i −1 ne 3, saka expression i x² − 2x − 3 > 0 chete.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.a: Mhinduro ye x² − 2x − 3 > 0 i x < −1 kana x > 3. Unofanira kusiyanisa chiitiko apo mhinduro iri pakati pema roots maviri nechiitiko apo iri kunze.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.b: Yakasimbiswa. Kuisa a = 1 i default, saka pane imwe chete.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.b: a = 1 i mutengo wawakasarudza wega. Dambudziko harina ruzivo rwekuti a = 1, uye harienderani nemamiriro ekuti mhinduro iri pakati pema roots maviri.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.c: Haina kusimbiswa. Hatigone kunyange kuziva simbi ye a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.r.c: Chokwadi chekuti mhinduro iri pakati pema roots maviri chinoreva kuti parabola ine chimiro che ∩ (inovhurika kumusoro-pasi), saka unogona kuziva simbi ye a.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.o.d: Haina kusimbiswa. a < 0, asi hukuru ine mikana yakawanda.
y-m-37-06.s.s1.explain: Ma roots maviri i −1 ne 3 uye mhinduro iri pakati pema roots maviri, saka a < 0. Ine chimiro a(x + 1)(x − 3) > 0, saka −x² + 2x + 3 > 0, −2x² + 4x + 6 > 0, ... , uye pane ma expressions asingaperi anogoneka.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.prompt: Wana ma integer triples (a, b, c) matatu akasiyana anoita quadratic inequality ax² + bx + c > 0 ine mhinduro −1 < x < 3 chaizvo.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora ma equations maviri mu a, b, c anoita kuti expression ive 0 kana ukaisa x = −1 ne x = 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa hukama pakati pe b, c dzawakawana ne a, gadzira mienzaniso nekuchinja mutengo we a, uye utarise simbi ye a.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Mutengo we expression pa x = −1 i 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Mutengo waunowana nekuisa x = −1 mu ax² + bx + c unofanira kuva 0. Pari zvino hauzi 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Mutengo we expression pa x = 3 i 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Mutengo waunowana nekuisa x = 3 mu ax² + bx + c unofanira kuva 0. Pari zvino hauzi 0.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Chimiro i chekuti mhinduro i interval iri pakati pema roots maviri.
y-m-37-06.s.s2.fail.c4: Tarisa simbi ye a zvakare. Kuti mhinduro ive interval iri pakati pema roots maviri, parabola inofanira kuva nechimiro chipi?
y-m-37-06.s.s2.explain: Integer triple chero ipi ine b = −2a, c = −3a uye a < 0, sa (−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6), (−3, 6, 9), ine mhinduro −1 < x < 3. Ma expressions i proportional, saka mhinduro dzakafanana.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukawedzera chimwe chezvinotevera paruzivo rwekuti mhinduro i −1 < x < 3, saka (a, b, c) inosimbiswa sechimwe. Ndechipi?
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.0: Pamienzaniso mitatu yawakagadzira kare, tarisa kana ruzivo rwesarudzo imwe neimwe rwatoshanda mune dzese.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kana ruzivo rwatoshanda mumienzaniso yese, haisi ruzivo rutsva. Wana sarudzo isingashande.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.a: Kana x = 0, mutengo we ax² + bx + c i 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.b: Axis ye symmetry ye quadratic function y = ax² + bx + c i x = 1.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.b: Kana mhinduro i −1 < x < 3, pakati pema roots maviri patoti x = 1. Wakadzokorora ruzivo rwatosanganisirwa.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.c: Ma roots maviri e equation ax² + bx + c = 0 i −1 ne 3.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.c: Kana i inequality ine mhinduro −1 < x < 3, unogona kuzivatova kuti ma roots e equation i −1 ne 3. Haisi ruzivo rutsva.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.o.d: a, b, c zvese i ma integers.
y-m-37-06.s.s3.r.d: Iri i mamiriro atopiwa, uye pane ma expressions akati wandei ane integer coefficients, sa (−1, 2, 3), (−2, 4, 6).
y-m-37-06.s.s3.explain: Mutengo pa x = 0 i c. Kana c = 3, saka kubva ku c = −3a tinowana a = −1, uye b = 2 inosimbiswa. Sarudzo dzakasara i zvaunogona kuziva kubva pamhinduro −1 < x < 3, saka hazvisi ruzivo rutsva. Nzira yekusarudza kana ruzivo i rutsva: tarisa kana ma expressions akasiyana akati wandei anogutsa ruzivo urwu achiri kusara.
